references.text: Psalm 112:1-3 speaks of the blessing of giving to the poor, which resonates with Jesus' call to sell what you have and give to the poor in order to have treasure in heaven.
Luke 12:33 also encourages selling possessions and giving to the poor as a way to store up treasures in heaven, paralleling Jesus' words in Matthew 19:21.
Acts 2:44-45 describes the first Christians who sold their possessions and shared with those in need, reflecting the principle Jesus taught in Matthew 19:21.
Hebrews 10:34 speaks of joy in sharing with those who suffer, which can be seen as a response to Jesus' call to give to the poor.
James 1:27 highlights the importance of helping those in need and keeping oneself unstained from the world, in line with Jesus' call to give to the poor.
1 Peter 4:17 speaks of the importance of doing good, especially toward those who belong to God's family, which can be related to giving to the poor as mentioned in Matthew 19:21.
